title: Continuity for the supplied cocone of restricted cohomology on neighbourhoods
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $x\in X$, $F$ an abelian etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and $q\in\mathbb N$. Let $D$ be a diagram of abelian groups on the opposite of the inclusion-ordered open neighbourhoods of x. Suppose isomorphisms $e_U:D(U)\simeq H^q(U_{et},j_U^{-1}F)$ identify its arrows with cohomological pullback along inclusions followed by inverse-image composition [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback], [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. Let $g_U:\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{X,x}\to U$ factor the canonical morphism through $j_U$. Suppose $B$ is a cocone for D and $b:B.pt\simeq H^q((\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{X,x})_{et},g_x^{-1}F)$, with each leg followed by b equal to e_U followed by pullback along g_U and the inverse-image composition comparison. Then B is a colimit cocone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Neither object cohomology on the original site nor eventual vanishing of classes is part of this statement.

proof.text: Let A be the full subcategory of open neighbourhoods of x consisting of affine opens. The affine basis clause of fromSpecStalk_limit_affine_neighbourhoods gives an object of A mapping to every neighbourhood. The fully faithful cofilteredness and initiality criteria therefore show A is cofiltered and its inclusion is initial. On opposites the inclusion is final.

The open inclusions define the diagram E:A to schemes and its natural transformation to X. The qcqs and affine-transition clauses of fromSpecStalk_limit_affine_neighbourhoods give its required instances. Cancel each open immersion to compare the supplied g with Mathlib fromSpecStalkOfMem. Transport the universal factorization clause of the same theorem to the cone with projections g; IsLimit.ofExistsUnique gives its limit property.

Whisker the supplied D and B with the opposite inclusion. Unfold cohomologyTriangleMap: hD and hB are exactly the transition and leg equations of nonempty_isColimit_cofiltered_fixed_base_cohomology. Apply it to E, its structure maps into X, the limit cone, and F. Final.isColimitWhiskerEquiv transfers this colimit property back to B.

theorem etaleRestrictedCohomology_neighbourhood_colimit
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (x : X) (q : ℕ)
    (D : (OpenNhds (X := X.toLocallyRingedSpace.toTopCat) x)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eD : ∀ U : OpenNhds (X := X.toLocallyRingedSpace.toTopCat) x,
      D.obj (op U) ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of
        (Sheaf.H ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (Scheme.Opens.ι U.1)).obj F) q))
    (hD : ∀ (U V : OpenNhds (X := X.toLocallyRingedSpace.toTopCat) x) (f : V ⟶ U),
      D.map f.op = (eD U).hom ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
        (Etale.cohomologyMap (X.homOfLE f.le)
          ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (Scheme.Opens.ι U.1)).obj F) q) ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Sheaf.H.map
          ((Etale.upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (X.homOfLE f.le)
            (Scheme.Opens.ι U.1) (Scheme.Opens.ι V.1)
            (X.homOfLE_ι f.le).symm).inv.app F) q) ≫ (eD V).inv)
    (g : ∀ U : OpenNhds (X := X.toLocallyRingedSpace.toTopCat) x,
      Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x) ⟶ (Scheme.Opens.toScheme U.1))
    (hg : ∀ U, X.fromSpecStalk x = g U ≫ (Scheme.Opens.ι U.1))
    (B : Cocone D)
    (b : B.pt ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of
      (Sheaf.H ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (X.fromSpecStalk x)).obj F) q))
    (hB : ∀ U, B.ι.app (op U) ≫ b.hom =
      (eD U).hom ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
        (Etale.cohomologyMap (g U)
          ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (Scheme.Opens.ι U.1)).obj F) q) ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Sheaf.H.map
          ((Etale.upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (g U) (Scheme.Opens.ι U.1)
            (X.fromSpecStalk x) (hg U)).inv.app F) q)) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit B)
